tasks.goal: Reject single and batch production-result maintenance before the owning window reaches productionEnd.

ReleaseWindowStore.findById is tenant scoped
updateResult and updateResults are transactional entry points
Neighboring release services use injectable Clock
invariants: Existing row-version, result validation and audit behavior remain

Early rejection performs no updateResult or appendResultLog call
non_goals: No API, database, controller, store or window-status change
action_bounds: Add ReleaseWindowStore and Clock dependencies to the service
Add one internal owning-window time check before existing mutation semantics
Add fixed-clock Mockito tests only in the existing production service test
acceptance: Before-end single call returns CONFLICT without persistence calls
Exact-boundary single call reaches existing successful update
evidence_required: Focused test red then green signal
tasks.rollback: Restore the pre-task service constructor/internal method and test fixture; no data rollback.
